subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Can the assigned Signal owner accept focused regression coverage without a linked Signal-account run, or should this PR require redacted after-fix bridge/send-receive evidence before merge?
rationale: Only a maintainer can decide whether unavailable-account proof is sufficient for this channel-facing behavior, and the protected label prevents automated cleanup or acceptance.

options.title: Require runtime evidence
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Signal debounce run or bridge log shows two inbound messages reaching the agent as separate lines.

options.title: Accept focused proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused regression coverage if the owner judges the narrow separator correction and CI coverage sufficient for Signal.

recommendation.title: Require runtime evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a redacted Signal debounce run or bridge log shows two inbound messages reaching the agent as separate lines.
